matched_dataset.join: each asset-month receives the latest jointly valid repository factor values on or before feature_asof_date
matched_dataset.timing: repository factors use the same one-completed-week lag as every base feature
matched_dataset.rows_missing_either_repository_factor: drop from both baseline and augmented variants
matched_dataset.target: unchanged cross-sectional rank of four-week relative return

walk_forward.training: expanding and strictly before each test year
walk_forward.label_embargo: training label_end_date strictly before test-year start

models.family_weighting: positive inner IC-minus-turnover score with equal fallback

promotion_gates.rank_ic: augmented adjusted lower bound positive and mean IC exceeds matched baseline
promotion_gates.portfolio_10bps: augmented Sharpe exceeds matched baseline with paired lower difference positive
promotion_gates.drawdown: augmented 10-bps drawdown no worse than matched baseline by more than two percentage points
promotion_gates.stress: augmented 100-bps later-window returns positive and full Sharpe no worse than matched baseline
promotion_gates.controls: augmented real IC and Sharpe exceed label-shuffle and random-feature controls
promotion_gates.fold_stability: at least 60 percent of augmented outer folds have positive mean rank IC
